semiconductor_relevance: High — NSS provides critical third-party evaluation, auditing, and certification services specifically for semiconductor manufacturing equipment and components.
summary: NSS is a third-party organization specializing in safety evaluations, audits, and certifications for semiconductor manufacturing equipment and components. They focus on compliance with safety standards such as SEMI and CE, offering consulting and support across North America, the EU, and Asia.
capabilities: Safety evaluations for semiconductor manufacturing equipment
Safety design consulting for semiconductor components
US FDA application and registration services for laser products

regional_presence.United States: NSS has a US affiliate, NSS Laboratory Inc., located in South Carolina, providing local services.
